title: SEC6: state counter as no-write witness oracle
description: Both peer_deliver_sender_mismatch_rejected (e2e.rs) and deliver_missing_identity_returns_server_fail (kith-peer tests) use the SQLite message state counter (get_state returning 's-0' or an unchanged value) as the independent oracle proving no database write occurred after a rejected request. This satisfies the CLAUDE.md test-integrity rule that a test must have an independent oracle: the state counter is maintained atomically with each INSERT and cannot be faked by the delivery code path. Checking the message ID directly in the store would only prove the row is absent; checking the counter proves no write of any kind happened.
